changes: Changed SnapshotLoader cache identity from captured_at to the resolved snapshot path, preventing distinct service files in the same capture batch from aliasing.
Added tests/test_loader.py regression test loading two distinct service snapshots with the same captured_at and asserting each service remains distinct.

actual_commands_outcomes.outcome: exit 0; JSON output includes api/api-13 and worker/worker-8, each with finished_at 2026-11-09T09:20:00Z; worker state is succeeded.

course_correction_evidence: The stage 1 command produced only api despite two fixture files having identical captured_at values. Source inspection showed the loader keyed its cache only on that timestamp and returned the first payload. Changed the cache key to resolved path; the documented command now exposes both services. No helper findings were requested or used.
acceptance_limits: Verified the public documented CLI command and all repository tests. Did not test cache behavior if a file is modified in place during a loader lifetime; that behavior is outside the stated multi-service requirement.
